landing78-pr.title: fix(dispatcher): preserve Codex carrier policy and launch diagnostics
landing78-pr.body:
Local Codex process launches previously received a forced permission override and lost precise pre-event launch errors. This change preserves host-selected permissions, retains actionable diagnostics, records stdin/initialization progress, and keeps Sprite's existing carrier behavior.

The owner has selected the physically verified macOS arm64 carrier for #78: Codex CLI 0.153.4, existing ChatGPT login, gpt-5.6-sol. On this exact head, the actual Noodle ProcessDispatcher launched an Agent that executed the event tool and produced one matching session/order/stage outcome in 21.30 seconds. [Receipt and raw traces](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/2e166473c4939f88fc55db3b78d96b85459ff728/evidence/78/macos-process-dispatch).

Validation: canonical pnpm check passed on exact head e6d712a2512547cdf78a85c1ee218e1ba52e3b27 with clean source (61.03 seconds); [Test](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35080572639) and [Actions worktree runtime](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35080572554) passed. [Historical startup controls](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/blob/9b79c142c95916a1983834e9ce7c656f68e66a54/evidence/78/stdin-initialization.json) include planted-defect failures and restored race-suite success. The macOS invalid-config refusal is GREEN, not a new defect RED.

The old /opt/codex/bin/codex carrier timeout remains unresolved historical evidence; this PR does not claim its root cause was fixed. Actions proves runtime behavior, not nested Agent execution. No credential/policy changes, production scheduling or Soodles #18 implementation are claimed. Delivery and reconciliation remain separate requirements.

Refs ed3c/noodle#78
